module: Explicit stored TABLECONTENT scalar, header and standalone style replacement
coverage: 24 independent adversarial API cases and 16 native-packet edit cases per configuration. Five native source profiles, eight distinct retained packets, ASCII and binary input/output.

Exact same-kind integer, double, string and Vector3 changes with explicit modern stored display text, legacy display-text prohibition, negative-zero distinction, original no-op snapshots and seed stability.
Stale, duplicate and foreign snapshot requests reject without mutation; successful edits retain prior Payload, StoredValues and References snapshots and require fresh tokens.

MoveNext and Dispose exceptions, caught nested replacement, changed source profile and removed owner anchor during disposal reject without packet or handle allocation. Independent callback document effects are not undone.
Literal structural-marker strings remain scalar/display data across both encodings. Invalid UTF-16, nonfinite requested values and strings exceeding the encoded escaped-length admission limit reject.

Explicit standalone actual opaque TABLESTYLE first-to-second-to-null replacements update exact dependencies and serialized group 340 while keeping prior References snapshots. Foreign same-handle targets reject. ACAD_TABLE-owned style changes reject.
Each native packet preserves exact loaded Payload on no-op; explicit first-scalar/header replacement retains all other tags, references and companion TABLECONTENT packets and reloads exactly.
All 64 output drawings audited with ezdxf 1.4.4: no errors or repairs. No native CAD runtime was available or claimed.
fixture_scope: Manifest-pinned unchanged whole R2013/R2018 source drawings plus the previously disclosed R2004/R2007/R2010 selected native packet carriers.
Group 999 comments are excluded only during raw transport conversion because binary DXF has no comment support. No TABLECONTENT source body changes precede the explicit API request.

Synthetic scalar carriers declare four same-kind frames within a qualified row/cell envelope without inferred row/column addressing. Synthetic opaque TABLESTYLE carriers explicitly use an unknown private subclass.

No-op preserves original loaded typed values and snapshot identities; it does not restore lexical spelling already normalized by the reader. Display strings are supplied explicitly; formatting, formulas and TABLE regeneration are not claimed.

findings.production_findings: No substantive production defect found against frozen c87afec. The supported DxfTag construction/read path already rejects nonfinite stored doubles.
findings.oracle_review: The owner gate now compares the companion TABLE subclass packet and complete proxy bytes separately from existing common-entity default normalization. Independent review additionally requested exact companion owner/reactor/extension metadata comparisons and a TABLE-owner corruption control; this is an oracle coverage recommendation, not a demonstrated production defect.
